q: Do I need to create an account?

q: What happens to my journal if I delete the app or get a new phone?
a: Your entries are erased, because they only live on your phone. To keep a copy, open the Journal and tap "Copy all entries," then paste them into your Notes app or an email to yourself.

q: Why did my saved affirmations disappear?
a: Saved items are stored in your phone's browser. Clearing your browser history or site data, or using a private browsing window, removes them.

q: How do I put the app on my home screen?
a: On iPhone, open app.anxiousblackgirls.com in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open it in Chrome, tap the menu (⋮), then Install app.

q: Does the app work without internet?
a: Yes, once you've opened it at least once with a connection. New articles and affirmations load the next time you're online.

q: Does anyone monitor what I write or read?
a: No. Nobody watches the app in real time. If you're in crisis, call 911 or call/text 988.

q: Where do the articles come from?
a: Every article is written for Black women and backed by published research, listed under Sources at the end. They're for learning, not for diagnosing yourself.

q: How often is new content added?
a: A new affirmation and journal prompt appear every day. We add new articles and topics over time.

q: I found a problem or have an idea. Who do I contact?
a: Email us at info@anxiousblackgirls.com. We'll get back to you as soon as we can. This inbox isn't monitored for emergencies. If you're in crisis, call 911 or call/text 988.
